results.title: Coroutines and Tasks — Python 3.12 documentation
excerpts: An asyncio TaskGroup is an asynchronous context manager holding a group of tasks. Tasks can be added to the group using create_task().
When the context manager exits, all tasks in the group are awaited. If any task fails with an unhandled exception, other unfinished tasks are cancelled.
The remaining tasks are waited on. Once all tasks have finished, any exceptions are combined into an ExceptionGroup and raised to the caller.
results.full_content:
Coroutines and Tasks

TaskGroup introduction.

In Python 3.12, TaskGroup provides a safer alternative to asyncio.gather(). When a child task in a TaskGroup raises an unhandled exception, all other active tasks in the group are immediately cancelled. After all tasks complete, any raised exceptions are aggregated into an ExceptionGroup and re-raised.
